The core (Zerodha login → live NIFTY/SENSEX quotes → margin) is proven on real input before other work; then the core domain and one vertical slice (Create Strategy → Configure Legs → Calculate → Save Draft → Connect Zerodha → Validate → Prepare Execution Plan → Review → Execute → Confirm Broker Execution → Reconcile → Active Monitoring) before broad UI work. |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-2 | Every domain invariant in spec/testing/core-invariants.md has an automated test. |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-3 | The failure paths in core-invariants.md §2 each have a test. |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-4 | Every meaningful UI change is screenshot-verified at desktop and mobile for loading, empty, error, blocked, active and (where relevant) reconciliation states. |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-5 | Parallel work starts only after the verification gate passes and never redefines strategy semantics, execution invariants, the state machine, formulas or reconciliation authority. |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-6 | Production deploys happen only after the owner's explicit authorization; Claude prepares, tests, validates and writes release notes and the deployment plan, then stops. |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-8 | The builder stops and asks the owner (never decides) when a licensing term would change what data can be displayed, stored or shared, or when a compliance/legal reading (SEBI, NSE/BSE, broker terms, advice wording) would change product behaviour (IC §10; ADR-029, ADR-014, ADR-034; audit S-IMPL-§10). |
| all | requirement | REQ-067 | AC-9 | Any external fact encoded as a rule, constant or user-facing claim (Zerodha, SEBI, NSE/BSE, market-data vendors, licence terms) cites an authoritative current source and the date checked, in the spec row or the code that holds it; a fact marked "to re-verify" or "not verified by us" is re-verified before code relies on it; lot sizes and strike gaps come only from the instrument master (M §0; ADR-042; audit S-MASTER-§0). |

| done | requirement | REQ-054 | AC-3 | Each broker's own token, trading symbol and segment code for a contract are stored in a per-broker table keyed to the contract's identity, with one broker code vocabulary; a contract with no row for a broker cannot be traded at that broker - no symbol is guessed or derived. The identity is (exchange segment, exchange token) while the contract is live: an exchange change of a live contract's expiry, strike or lot is a revision with history; after the contract's expiry has passed its token is retired, and a later row with that token is a new contract (ADR-057, correcting ADR-052). A contract the daily list stops carrying before its expiry is marked delisted and kept, and its token is free for reuse (ADR-058). A change on a live token is a revision only when the underlying and type are unchanged and either the expiry moved by at most 6 days with the same strike or the strike changed with the same expiry; any other change makes the old contract delisted and the row a new contract; an identical returning delisted contract is reinstated (ADR-059). |
